payload.body:
## Customer impact
A customer on tenant `northstar` reports the csv-export-v1 workflow still fails.
Related engineering issue: #41. This issue is not being reopened; the fix may not have reached this tenant.

## Reproduction (redacted)
Contract `csv-export-v1`, reporting period `2026-08`, manifest revision 1, app revision 1, config revision 1.

## Expected vs observed
Expected 1 records. Observed: HTTP 200; 0 of 1 expected records; result FAIL (CSV records did not exactly match the manifest).
Request ID `28be8483-0756-434e-96c6-3e1152c3e143`, checked at 2026-09-13T22:51:59.171Z.

## Next engineering question
Is the corrected export path enabled for this tenant's configuration?
